name: Xue Daoheng 薛道衡
bio: Xue Daoheng (540–609) was a statesman and poet who served the Northern Qi, the Northern Zhou and the Sui dynasty. Born in Fenyin (in present-day Shanxi), he rose to high office under the Sui founder Emperor Wen and was admired as one of the leading literary men of the north.

He is remembered above all for the line 空梁落燕泥, 'swallows' mud falls from the empty beam', in his poem 昔昔鹽, a lament of a wife whose husband is away at the frontier. Under Emperor Yang of Sui he fell out of favour, and in 609 he was ordered to take his own life; tradition says the emperor, who envied his talent, resented that line's fame.

poems.title: 昔昔鹽 (Xi xi yan)
poems.author: Xue Daoheng 薛道衡
poems.text:
垂柳覆金堤，蘼蕪葉復齊。
水溢芙蓉沼，花飛桃李蹊。
採桑秦氏女，織錦竇家妻。
關山別蕩子，風月守空閨。
恆斂千金笑，長垂雙玉啼。
盤龍隨鏡隱，綵鳳逐帷低。
飛魂同夜鵲，倦寢憶晨鷄。
暗牖懸蛛網，空梁落燕泥。
前年過代北，今歲往遼西。
一去無消息，那能惜馬蹄。

poems.title: 敬酬楊僕射山齋獨坐 (Jing chou Yang puye shanzhai du zuo)
poems.author: Xue Daoheng 薛道衡
poems.text:
相望山河近，相思朝夕勞。
龍門竹箭急，華岳蓮花高。
岳高障重疊，鳥道風煙接。
遙原樹若薺，遠水舟如葉。
葉舟旦旦浮，驚波夜夜流。
露寒洲渚白，月冷函關秋。
秋夜清風發，彈琴即鑒月。
雖非莊舄歌，吟詠常思越。

poems.title: 人日思歸 (Renri si gui)
poems.author: Xue Daoheng 薛道衡
poems.text:
入春纔七日，離家已二年。
人歸落雁後，思發在花前。
